title: Uwurondera Ukuri Ashikamye
intro: Mu gihe cari gipfutse ubujuju be n’ugusenga imana z’ikinyoma, harabaye urugendo rukomeye rw’ukwizera. Uwo muntu yararwanya ingingo mfatirwako zo mu kibano cabo, arondera Umuremyi umwe w’Ukuri afise ukwemera kudahungabana. Nimwitegure guhishura akaranga k’umutima iragi ryawo rikomeza gutera intege abantu amamiliyoni.
clues: Narabajije ibiremwa vyo mw’ijuru, nshaka Umukama w’ukuri arema vyose kandi akabitunga.
Nategetswe kuva mu gihugu canje, nja mu gihugu cahezagiwe na Allah.
Nararwanya ibigirwamana vy’abantu banje, nhangana n’ubusa bwavyo ata guca ku ruhande mu kubimenagura.
Najugunywe mu muriro w’agahomerabunwa n’abantu banje, yamara warabaye umuco n’amahoro kuri jewe kubera itegeko rya Allah.
Narageragejwe n’itegeko ryo gutanga umuhungu wanje w’imfura nkunda cane, ikigeragezo co kuyoboka ata gukeka.
Jewe n’umuhungu wanje twashizeho imishinge y’Inzu ya mbere yo Gusengeramwo kw’Isi, ahantu heranda h’abantu bose.
arabic: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًۭا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verse: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham." (21:69)
